Test Description: This testcase performs DBI random payload stress testing across the DMAC, subsystem, and host domains. It configures the PHY interface via PHY_IF_CFG (offset 0xA4: fields n_lanes[1:0] set to 3, phy_stop_wait_time[15:8] set to 0x40), the packet handler via PCKHDL_CFG (offset 0x2C: value 0x3D enabling eotp_tx_en, eotp_rx_en, bta_en, ecc_rx_en, crc_rx_en, eotp_tx_lp_en), and the clock manager via CLKMGR_CFG (offset 0x8: value 0x107 setting tx_esc_clk_division=0x07, to_clk_division=0x01). It disables DPI output via the dpi_control register (offset 0x24: dbi_dpi_en=0). It enables DMAC interrupts. In a loop of 10 iterations, it generates random pixel counts (multiples of 8 up to 8192), reconfigures DBI command size, loads random data and write commands into SRAM, programs 2-channel DMA descriptors, and executes them. It polls the DMAC masked interrupt status until both channels complete (value 0x3), then clears the interrupts.
